draft.subject: Next step after your first Union Collective project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for making time for the welcome call last week, and nice work getting your first project up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the most useful next move.

If it would help to have someone alongside you, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to work through that first project together and make sure it matches how your team actually works.

Best,
Chidi
